items.title: The actual common-sign averaged Gaussian law (Eq6)

source.anchor: Section2 S2.p2.1 and actual Gaussian target; Section3.1 Eq4-Eq6 and zero residual S3.SS1.p3.2; AppendixB.3 regularity. Ex70-72 are downstream context.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. Eq6 prints the averaged product law; ASTIS supplies its omitted measurable-family, matrix-prior transport and independent-averaging details.
source.scope: The actual common-sign prior-averaged law, with explicit coordinate pushforward, probabilities and positive support. No main lower-bound or density/amplification credit.

items.statement:

The actual matrix prior is \(\mathcal D_b=( oldsymbol O\mapsto A_{ oldsymbol O})_{\#}

u_b(O)\) and \( ar\pi_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_b(A)\). These are bind-mixtures of the canonical Gaussian constructor. They are not defined to be the claimed product. The matrix carrier uses its usual finite-dimensional Borel structure. assumptions: \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), with inclusive endpoints. Put \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\).

Fix one \(b\in\{-1,+1\}\). For full real orthogonal Haar probability \(\mu_n\), set \(\nu_b=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=b\}}\), and draw the blocks independently from this same fixed law. The signs are not drawn independently.

The literal precision matrices are \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\) and \(A_{\boldsymbol O}=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\). The actual matrix prior is \(\mathcal D_b=(\boldsymbol O\mapsto A_{\boldsymbol O})_{\#}\nu_b^{\otimes k}\).

The actual laws are \(P_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\,d\nu_b(O)\) and \(\bar\pi_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_b(A)\). These are bind-mixtures of the canonical Gaussian constructor. They are not defined to be the claimed product.

The matrix carrier uses its usual finite-dimensional Borel structure. The theorem proves that \(\mathcal D_b\), \(P_b\) and \(\bar\pi_b\) are probabilities, and that \(A\succ0\) for \(\mathcal D_b\)-almost every \(A\). Positive definiteness, Gaussian-kernel measurability and mixture factorization are conclusions or internal producers, never caller hypotheses.

The split takes consecutive coordinates \((x_j)_i=x_{jn+i}\) and \(z_t=x_{kn+t}\) in zero-based indices. It is the same coordinate bijection used by the literal block precision. No isometry for the ordinary product norm is asserted. If \(r=0\), the residual is the unique probability point mass on the zero-dimensional space; its unit factor agrees with the source omission convention.

assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly these inequalities and the same numerical common sign; no query-budget restriction or independent per-block signs.
assumption_deltas.reason: All source construction endpoints are retained. The later n=2T+1 choice belongs to the main lower bound.

assumption_deltas.lean: D is literally the product-prior map through canonical blockPrecision; gamma is the actual inverse-precision Gaussian; D.bind gamma is the average. Probability, D-a.e.PD and kernel measurability are proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: This completes omitted construction/transport/probability bookkeeping, with no producer supplied as a premise or desired product definition.
